baselines.b2_original: batch05 B2 saved predictions (descriptive read-only comparator)
baselines.existing_batch05_ridge: batch05 saved comp44+count ridge predictions (matched gene IDs, descriptive)
baselines.hgb: sklearn HistGradientBoostingRegressor(max_iter=200, learning_rate=.1, max_leaf_nodes=15, l2_regularization=.1, early_stopping=False, random_state=20261011), outer train only
baselines.ridge_comp44_count: reproduced current ridge comp44+count with nested/inner rules

combination.fixed_mean: finalridge + arithmetic mean of the two seed residual outputs

evaluation.acceptance: fixedmean vs EACH simple baseline >= .02 test Spearman gain with bootstrap 95% LB > 0 AND >= 3% relative MAE reduction; individual seeds nonnegative gain

features.comp44: per-promoter mono(4)+dinuc(16)+GC(1)+length(1) for sym400 and up2000 => 44; gene=mean over promoters

inner_holdout.used_for: ridge alpha selection within each 4-fold subset AND full outer train final ridge selection

label.definition: rank-scaled [0,1] gene-level expression strength; E_raw=mean over tissues of log2(1+TPM); Score_E=rank(E_raw)/(n-1) over canonical 58988-gene table, stable-sort ties

neural.architecture: batch03 GeneBagModel: Trunk(conv1 4->64 k7, conv2 64->64 k5, conv3 64->128 k5, BN+ReLU); head Linear(256,1) on concat(mean,max)
neural.target: MSE residual target = canonical Score_E - OOF ridge prediction (outer train)

outer_folds.algorithm: components sorted by gene_count desc, tie-break seeded hash; greedy assign to bin minimizing (count+size)/target_fraction (target 0.2 each)

question: Does a from-scratch gene-bag CNN predicting honest component-fold OOF ridge residuals add predictive value beyond composition/count baselines, on the SAME corrected batch05 split?

ridge.scaling: z-score using inner-train (selection) / full outer train (final fit) only

scope: gene-level Score_E ranking only; NOT promoter/construct/HEK293T activity
